rules.title: Santa Ana annual maximum allowable rent increase
rules.requirement: A landlord may raise rent only by a limited amount each year: no more than 3% of current rent or 80% of the CPI change, whichever is less. The current maximum for Sept 1, 2026 through Aug 31, 2027 is 2.87%.
rules.coverage_text: Rental units covered by the Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance; the page does not state coverage limits.
rules.key_value: Lesser of 3% or 80% of CPI change; 2.87% for 2026-09-01 to 2027-08-31
rules.citation: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: The increase cannot be more than 3% of your current rent or 80% of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) change, whichever is less.

rules.title: Santa Ana just cause eviction requirement
rules.requirement: A landlord must have a valid reason to evict a tenant, such as nonpayment of rent, lease violation, or the landlord moving in. Relocation assistance may be owed for certain evictions.
rules.coverage_text: Tenants in units covered by the ordinance; the page does not state coverage limits.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Your landlord must have a valid reason to evict you.
